answer.original_source: NN, Inc. (company announcement, late June 2026; the record relays it via finance.yahoo.com dated 2026-07-01, with no stored pieces to match)
answer.new_information: NN, Inc. announced in late June 2026 that it would add 47 machine centers for liquid cooling production at its Wuxi, China plant for NVIDIA AI data center racks, and said 100% of the new capacity is pre-sold under multi-year, multi-product awards. It targets US$80-US$90 million of accretive new business in 2026 from the expansion (a company target, not a result or guidance on revenue). NN was removed from the Russell Microcap Value Index in late June 2026. The 2028 figures are not company guidance: US$485.5m revenue and US$47.9m earnings are a Simply Wall St style narrative projection, and US$489.5m revenue and US$48.3m earnings are unnamed analysts' estimates (rumour tier). Limitations: the pre-sold claim and the capacity count are company-stated with no independent verification in the text; the 2028 projections are period-matched only to each other and carry no stated definition, so they are background and do not move a company-guided number.
